One production _render entry (Markdown), one PUT, one render row and one receipt, zero DELETE/MKCOL; original preparation claim unchanged. Repeated same/new IDs after publication cause no render or effect.
evidence.native: Real Chromium fetch, actual HTTP 303 followed to HTML before production handler; restored synthetic auth and reload with zero new POST; human click with identical five fields, successful SQL/DAV publication followed by lost JSON reply, coherent GET/read receipt and reload without effects. Relative counters verified with an earlier synthetic publication present.
evidence.transport_boundaries: Browser M5 replaces fetch; native M9A test does not. Both provider/faculties and DAV peer in native test are synthetic loopback. SQL race uses production store/claims/executor with synthetic DAV; no Writer process.
